newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk Jan-Sept nickel, copper output flat yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk Jan-Sept nickel, copper output flat yr/yr.

text.p: Russian metals group Norilsk Nickel output of nickel and copper for the first nine months of the year were little changed from year-ago levels, a spokesman said on Thursday.

Sergei Vetchinin said refined nickel production over January to September was 0.9 percent higher than in the same period in 1995 while refined copper output fell 1.4 percent. Refined cobalt production rose 1.7 percent.
RAO Norilsky Nikel does not give monthly output figures in absolute terms, but Vetchinin said metals production was close to planned levels.
Nickel output in the first nine months was 97.8 percent of the company's planned level, copper 102.3 percent and cobalt output 99.4 percent, he said.
